policy.scope: Contact-free planar grounded four-body fixture; 1200 ticks per case, sampled at tick 1 and every 60 ticks; stiffness 3 N/m.
policy.rationale: Independent60-to80digit final state differences are below4e-61. A double-precision accumulation scale64*EPS*4800*9^2 is5.53e-9 for normalized order-one values;1e-8 is the rounded engineering comparison threshold,100times tighter than existing paired1e-6 limits. This operation-count estimate is not a rigorous conditioned forward-error bound. Threshold is fixed before viewing candidate results, and does not replace conservation, energy, translation, stop or powered checks.
policy.limitations: Finite-fixture regression, not a universal enclosure or continuous-model equivalence certificate. Same threshold must hold across declared compared masses; reference integration mismatch is diagnosed rather than absorbed by raising threshold. R-I discretization discrepancy is reported separately.
